name: Spring-charging motor run contact
summary: Reports that the charging motor is operating rather than merely commanded.
description: Reports that the charging motor is operating rather than merely commanded. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Motor running feedback” at the input and “Charging-running indication” at the output. A run command does not prove rotation.
